visual_review.findings: Four separated items with coordinated red, gold, cyan and ivory colors and clear dark contours. The result has faceted painterly shading and weak secondary cut-paper traits.
visual_review.small_size: The four item types are distinguishable at 128 pixels. No in-game UI interaction test was performed.

visual_findings: The original and light/dark composites were visually inspected. The result leans toward faceted painterly shading; the secondary cut-paper traits are weak. Technical alpha checks do not establish engine validation or user acceptance.
request_original: 以 G03 清晰赛璐璐为主，结合 G10 的剪纸造型，成组生成药水、钥匙、宝石与卷轴，统一光照，背景透明。
request: Generate a grouped potion, key, gem and scroll using G03 with G10 cut-paper shapes as secondary traits, shared lighting and a transparent background.
